---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or surface
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Question it should answer** — the platform question a user wants
answered, not the implementation.

**Evidence source** — what artifacts/facts would back the answer?
(Features without an evidence path are declined by design.)

**Boundary fit** — is it read-only core, adapter/host-side, or a new
agent surface? If agentic: which role (specialist/reviewer/executor)?

**Out of scope** — what it must deliberately NOT do.
